translation:
[Here begins Shri Heli ||4||. Every verse opens with the refrain "heli re" - "O friend".]

1. O friend, the Supreme Brahman who is unmanifest - He is the first, the Supreme Self. ||1||
2. O friend, He whose three portions create, sustain and dissolve. ||2||
3. O friend, Brahma and the rest are [only] souls - He does not fall within their perception. ||3||
4. O friend, the primal One, alone and unstained - yet He spreads Himself out into very many [forms]. ||4||
5. O friend, He is unmoving and imperishable - in play He makes what exists cease to exist. ||5||
6. O friend, gods, men and nagas (serpent beings) serve Him - all abide in Your dwelling. ||6||
7. O friend, Sanak and the other sages and yogis - however they search, they never reach His limit. ||7||
8. O friend, He from whom all comes into separate being - and in whom again all sets [like the sun]. ||8||
9. O friend, incomprehensible, unseen, undivided - the Vedas praise Him without ceasing. ||9||
10. O friend, He is satisfied without any food - all joys wait upon Him in service. ||10||
11. O friend, He has neither birth nor death - He who created them both. ||11||
12. O friend, let His glory be sung - let us praise the power and qualities of Hari. ||12||
13. O friend, He is the father of all - yet He Himself has no mother or father. ||13||
14. O friend, He is the master of all - and He has no master over Him. ||14||
15. O friend, He is above all - and above Him nothing has been created. ||15||
16. O friend, He has no equal - what comparison, then, can I give for Him? ||16||
17. O friend, by Him the world is driven on - tormented in the wildfire of delusion. ||17||
18. O friend, with form and without form, endless - however much one tells of Him, He cannot be told. ||18||
19. O friend, He whom the Vedas do not fathom - hard even for the mind of the lord of yogis to reach. ||19||
20. O friend, knowing this, serve Him always - You alone ever are; I am not. ||20||
21. O friend, in this way efface the self - serve the Father, and He will remember you. ||21||
22. O friend, day and night I bow to Him - day and night I repeat [the Name of] the Supreme Brahman. ||22||
23. O friend, at the last hour the soul remains - dragged by its karma it wanders through the ages. ||23||
24. O friend, the soul is broken by delusion - [so] lust, anger and pride are cast away. ||24||
25. O friend, You alone are free of fear - deeds done [in You] do not cling. ||25||
26. O friend, almighty Creator - the karma written on the head must be borne. ||26||
27. O friend, for the sake of establishing dharma (right order) - He came down in a single portion of Himself. ||27||
28. O friend, [it was] for the good of others - incomparable are Your deeds. ||28||
29. O friend, You have no work of Your own to do - in You there is no attachment, hatred or pride. ||29||
30. O friend, no fault is in You - the King does whatever He wills. ||30||

[Thus ends Shri Heli, complete ||4||]
